visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a tan baseball cap and a navy blue striped jacket with multiple colorful patches sits in a black gaming chair. He is holding a blue game controller and appears focused on an off-screen monitor. The setting is a modern indoor living space with a corridor and wooden paneling in the background. (2) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light grey long-sleeved top and a short black skirt, enters from a door in the background hallway. She walks toward the man while performing rhythmic arm movements and a slight dance. (3) The woman reaches the man's chair and places both hands on the headrest. The man looks up and smiles toward the camera as she prepares to pull the chair. (4) The woman suddenly yanks the chair backward at extreme speed. The man and the chair are dragged into the hallway through a doorway, creating a motion blur effect that makes them appear to vanish into the distance instantly. (5) The man is briefly seen disappearing into the dark doorway, leaving the foreground empty as the woman stands in the corridor looking toward the camera.
